description: Agent directory: the state of a directory listing or submission. Input submission_id, or url as a listed website or MCP endpoint. The signed report states live (with its layer, the verification it passed when listed, the auth label when its MCP handshake passed anonymously and the date verified), queued, in operator review (with the checks to fix) or not found, read only from the directory listings and its review queue. POST /api/directory-status. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/directory/.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of submission_id or url.

submission_id.description: A submission ID returned by wever_directory-submit or the directory form.

url.description: A listed website or MCP endpoint URL.
